name: METRONIDAZOLE / DIODOHYDROXYQUINOLEINE SUSPENSION 120 ML 1 PIECE
description: The metronidazole and diiodohydroxyquinoline suspension in a 120 ml bottle is an antiparasitic medication used to treat intestinal infections such as amebiasis and giardiasis. Metronidazole attacks parasites in the tissues, while diiodohydroxyquinoline acts directly in the intestine. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
